name: shellmail
description: Full email client for AI agents via the ShellMail API. Read inbox, extract OTP codes, and search messages; also send and reply to email, mark/archive/permanently delete messages, and create, recover, or delete the ShellMail address itself. Destructive commands require --confirm and explicit user approval. Network access is limited to the ShellMail API.

SHELLMAIL_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for ShellMail API authentication (grants full access to inbox contents, OTPs, sending, deletion, and address management)

SHELLMAIL_API_URL.description: API base URL (only change for self-hosted instances)
